title: Pairing with a rank-one matrix
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\gamma,x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The pairing of the matrix with entries $\gamma_i\gamma_j$ against $x$ and $y$ equals $(\gamma\cdot x)(\gamma\cdot y)$ in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
